name: omplia-contract-forge
description: Draft contracts from your own prior contracts with enforced provenance: every clause traceable to a real source, hallucinated clauses blocked. Bilingual EN/ES. Zero dependencies.

interface.shortDescription: Provenance-enforced contract drafting from your own contracts
interface.longDescription: Assemble contract drafts from a folder of your existing contracts (.docx, .pdf, .txt, .md). A deterministic engine ingests, classifies (EN/ES), filters, ranks and validates; the agent only drafts on top of retrieved clauses. A validation gate rejects any clause that does not trace to a real source. State persists in ~/.omplia/contract-forge across sessions and agents.
defaultPrompt: Draft a contract for a new client using my old contracts as a template
